verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a Container Runtime that runs an OCI container image built from a Dockerfile or Containerfile at the project root, with guidance for migrating an existing Docker app and a separate Container Registry product. Its marketing also states production workloads run in isolated containers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Docker deploys, and detail on deploying prebuilt images from the registry rather than root Dockerfile builds; the containers run within Vercel Functions limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy applications packaged as Docker containers

citations.quote: Run any code and library on Vercel Functions with an OCI container image built from a Dockerfile or Containerfile at the project root.
Run production workloads in isolated containers on Vercel.
